[[Chinwe]] is an enthusiastic inventor planning his next great creation. He also collects [[Trophy|trophies]] in exchange for weapons.

==Locations==
*[[The Desolation]]
**{{NPC location|The Shattered Ravines}}

==Dialogue==
:''"You might not believe it, but I'm a great inventor! I invented the flibbertigibbet and the codwumple. I'm sure you use those every day, don't you? Now I'm working on my most amazing project ever - a balloon that will take me across the sea all the way to [[Tyria]]! Imagine how suprised they'll be when my wonderful balloon sails into [[Lion's Arch]]. But to make it work, I need a bellows. Retrieve for me 5 [[Dusty Insect Carapace]]s from those [[insect]]s out there, and I'll give you something else I invented:"''
